content:
Section: Nimbus Labs SOC 2 Type II Summary > Results

The auditor noted two exceptions during the period:

One quarterly access review was completed 6 days after the due date in Q1 2026.One terminated contractor retained read-only access to a staging tool for 2 days after their contract ended.

Both exceptions were remediated and closed before the report was issued. No exceptions related to encryption, backups or incident response.
